name: igus ReBeLMove with ReBeL cobot arm
summary: igus' low-cost person-safe AMR (PLd safety laser scanner, 50 kg load, 1.5 m/s) sold on the RBTX marketplace in a version with igus' own six-axis ReBeL plastic cobot arm mounted on it.

germany.statusNote: RBTX (igus, Cologne) lists the ReBeLMove with collaborative robot arm at 35,673.30 € plus VAT and shipping with a cart button and a usual delivery time of 3 weeks; the AMR alone (RBTX-IGUS-0258) is 29,838 €.

sellers.name: RBTX marketplace (igus SE & Co. KG)
sellers.note: Art.-Nr. RBTX-IGUS-0259; page shows "35.673,30 €", "zzgl. MwSt. und Versand", "In den Warenkorb" and "Übliche Lieferzeit: 3 Wochen". Scope listed: ReBeLMove, charger, charging dock with frame, rugged tablet, Bluetooth controller, first year of support and updates.

specs.label: Weight
specs.conditions: as listed on the page; whether it includes the arm is not stated

specs.label: Safety
specs.value: Safety laser scanner, dual-channel emergency stop, motor encoders and brakes; Performance Level d; safety cannot be switched off
specs.quote: Diese umfassen: Sicherheitslaserscanner, Zweikanaliger Not-Halt, Encoder an den Motoren und Bremsen an beiden Motoren. Mit einem Performance Level D (PLd)

specs.label: Fleet management
specs.value: Distributed over Wi-Fi; external VDA 5050 fleet managers can be used
specs.quote: Alternativ können externe VDA5050-Flottenmanager wie idealworks, Naise, MHP oder Kinexon genutzt werden.

notes: The arm is igus' six-axis ReBeL (the page offers the CAD file ReBeL-6DOF); arm payload and reach were not shown on the page as read.
No gripper is listed in the scope of delivery.
igus' wheeled humanoid iggyRob (separate record) uses the larger ReBeLMove Pro with two ReBeL arms.

images.alt: igus ReBeL move mobile base with a ReBeL arm

evidence.task: Seller offers it as an autonomous mobile robot for internal transport with a cobot arm on board

openQuestions: Payload and reach of the fitted ReBeL arm, and whether a gripper is included (RBTX page text did not show them).
Runtime per charge and IP rating not shown.
Page read with a rendered browser; the price is net ("zzgl. MwSt. und Versand").
